events.title: ORBIT 002: Noncompliant, Flange, sina, AIDEL, Adri, Duck Trash
events.description:
Divalocity returns for their second orbit around the sun with Noncompliant, a Midwest rave fixture and mentor of resident @duck_trash, is a master of a no-frills techno beatdown. Joined by priestess of @intellephunk, Flange brings mind bending acid house along with local standout Sina bringing a galaxy storms of acid techno to the dance floor.

Orbit 002 resident AIDEL joins the Divalocity team alongside residents Duck Trash and Adri, opening a realm of genre bending selections designed to take you on unexpected journeys.

Celebrating another year of Queer resilience at the peak time of seasonal decline, let our dance floor be there for you when you need it most.
